scope: Source review of Crew-relevant backend flows and current APK integration for new users with no investments. Not a full security audit, database integration run, or production certification.

reviewed.finding: Privy account, profile and Crew role are available. App home differs between authenticated users and developer preview.
Authenticated Crew users render VaultHomePanel; the elaborate sample portfolio renders for preview access.
Success with no personal vaults shows basic no-investments text and Explore vaults. Keep loading and errors separate from genuine empty state.
Captain directory and public profiles support username search, pagination and sorting; stale metrics become unavailable. No personalized recommendation or follow API was found in reviewed paths.
Public list, name search, phase and duration filters, Captain filtering, details and performance; private own-vault list and position data. Demo vaults are read-only.

Wallet-snapshot mode can initialize virtual funds once from linked devnet SOL/USDC holdings. Source tokens remain in the wallet. Initialization checks linked-wallet ownership and rejects empty wallet. Do not hardcode a starting cash amount or combine paper and real wallet balance.

50 paper USDC minimum Crew contribution; 30,000 total round capacity; only before funding closes in FUNDRAISING. Captain cannot contribute via Crew route. 10% performance fee on total net round profit at final settlement.

Contribution checks current terms hash, time/phase/capacity, available paper cash and paused-contribution flag. Uses idempotent operations and financial locks; this source observation is not a complete security guarantee.
Crew cancellation before fundraising deadline; funds locked during trading; claims only after final settlement with ownership and duplicate-claim checks.
Authenticated, paginated personal vault-operation activity can distinguish a genuinely new user from one with historical/cancelled investments.
Older v0 join/exit and paper-position routes coexist with v1 rounds. New empty-state CTAs should use current round flow rather than imply legacy anytime exits.
Fund chat posting requires Captain or a current shareholding member. New-user designs should not imply existing membership.
Authenticated personal notification feed and read actions exist; do not invent new unread events for first-use screens.
Paper wallet summary is separate from direct devnet balances; external wallet connection UI currently remains a disabled placeholder.
Separate devnet onchain creation and exit flow is Captain-gated for creation; do not present it as proof of a general live Crew investment journey.

coverage: Minimums, capacity, deadline and Captain role
checks.limitation: Tests imported existing compiled domain output; source constants were inspected independently. No DB-backed integration tests or production calls were run.

stateGuidance: Show first-use empty state only after successful authenticated data load.
An empty investment list does not imply an empty wallet.
Show separate load-error/retry and no-investable-vault states.
Returning users without current positions should retain history access.
Use backend paper-mode/configuration flags; show setup when required.
Use public discovery and review terms before contributing; no forced funding before exploration.

recommendation.reason: One clear first action, no invented portfolio metrics, close fit to existing coastal home identity.
recommendation.alternative: 03-guided-start.png for users who need more explanation.
recommendation.implementationStatus: No app or backend code changed.
